title: Consolidate the read-side agent-monitoring shard-glob call sites into one shared resolver
summary: Built monitoring_shard_paths.py and migrated all 9 independent read-widening glob sites (re-enumerated from scratch, found a 10th unnamed site and corrected two false negatives in the design brief) plus monitoring_consolidation.py's own narrower glob, onto it; AC5 guard asserts zero occurrences of the fragile idiom anywhere, stronger than the exactly-one originally proposed.
